visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a spacious, brightly lit indoor exhibition hall with a high industrial ceiling. A middle-aged Asian man with short black hair, wearing an olive-drab t-shirt and grey tactical pants, stands centrally. He gestures broadly towards the background, which features various camping setups, including a large tan tent and a portable fire pit with a tripod. (2) The man moves closer to three camping chairs of different colors including khaki, black, and dark grey. He picks up the central black chair and demonstrates its adjustable legs by pulling them out and clicking them into place. He squats low to show the mechanism to the camera, then stands back up to present the fully extended chair. (3) Transitioning to a demonstration under a tan tarp, the man sits on a low chair before a black storage box acting as a table. He handles a set of stainless steel cookware, showing a detachable handle being clipped onto a deep pot, a shallow pan, and a flat plate. He demonstrates the nesting capability by stacking them together efficiently. (4) Finally, the man stands before a large, detailed orange poster titled with the brand logo CAMPFIRE. He points out specific sections regarding discounts and gifts. He then walks past a wooden display wall featuring various outdoor tools and accessories, speaking directly to the camera with high hand-gesture frequency to conclude.
